summary: Frontend-only validation executed for Setup Documents, per-document status/consent, delete flow, and A/B isolation. Setup section renders and lists user docs; delete removes document from list after refresh; A/B isolation passed by document-name visibility check. Per-document consent failed due missing DB migration columns (400 on Supabase user_documents queries).
